title: Hyphal graph-to-wave reduction and adaptive fidelity tournament
biological_claim_ceiling: No biological validation, SOTA superiority, or universal fungal-growth law is established by this protocol.

scientific_references.role: explicit 3D hyphal morphology and transport reference
time-resolved AMF topology plus measured intra-hyphal cytoplasmic flow
scientific_references.scope: three AMF profiles in a 2D-constrained in-vitro root-organ-culture system

units.biomass: source_defined; never infer from image intensity
units.transport: source_defined; element-specific SI or declared compatible units

model_families.description: Pinned published BMX high-detail discrete hyphal model
Source-faithful sBARE reduction derived from the preprint
Explicit topology graph with fixed high-detail fidelity
Source-derived dynamic graphs and ROI-linked measured cytoplasmic flow

task_families.name: drift_diffusion_nonidentifiability
task_families.intervention: paired micro-parameter sets with matched mean front speed and different front variance

task_families.name: held_out_environment_transfer
task_families.intervention: unseen nutrient / geometry combinations within a declared envelope

task_families.name: amf_graph_flow_coevolution
task_families.intervention: time-resolved graph and ROI-linked flow observations from the admitted AMF travelling-wave study

fairness_rules: same initial conditions and intervention for every compared model
same observation operators and spatial/temporal support
same held-out cases and scoring code
compare at matched observable error and uncertainty coverage, not just equal step count
report preprocessing, compilation, warm-up and solver costs separately
do not treat model-generated pseudo-observations as independent ground truth

adaptive_refinement_policies.purpose: negative/control baseline only; not an admissible authority
refine when per-observable error/residual crosses declared limits
refine before an enabled process requires unrepresented information

promote_before_use_when: enabled process requires segment-level topology or identity
root/fungal interface calculation requires graph-resolved geometry
topology or transport residual exceeds preregistered bound
candidate is outside the reduced model validity envelope
demotion_allowed_only_when: all enabled processes have a qualified sufficient coarse representation
future-bearing state and history have a reconstruction/preservation contract
conservation and selected observables remain within declared bounds

preregistered_stretch_targets.speedup_target: at least 10x lower wall-clock on at least one larger workload vs pinned explicit mechanics
preregistered_stretch_targets.comparability_condition: only count if matched preregistered observable error and uncertainty coverage are achieved
preregistered_stretch_targets.worst_stratum: no material degradation in worst-condition front, density, topology or transport metrics
preregistered_stretch_targets.invariants: 100% pass on non-negotiable deterministic topology, source, mass/element-balance and event-idempotency fixtures

receipt_requirements: exact source revisions and artifact checksums
scenario manifest and complete input/configuration digests
observation operator and metric implementation revision
flow observation to graph edge / ROI / replicate / timepoint association identity
root/global efficiency normalization method and MST/DT reference revisions
separate flow velocity, volumetric flow, graph efficiency and tracer-delivery observables
